files.content:
# Panduan Deployment ke Shared Hosting PHP (cPanel / DirectAdmin / VPS)

Panduan langkah demi langkah untuk memasang **Support Septian** pada URL produksi:
`https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support`

---

## Prasyarat Hosting
- **PHP 8.1 / 8.2 / 8.3**
- **MySQL 8.0+** atau **MariaDB 10.4+**
- Ekstensi PHP aktif: `pdo_mysql`, `openssl`, `mbstring`, `json`, `dom`, `fileinfo`, `curl`
- *(Opsional jika memakai mode Google App Password untuk membaca Inbox)*: aktifkan ekstensi `imap` di menu **Select PHP Version** pada cPanel.
- SSL/HTTPS aktif untuk `https://septianfr.web.id` (wajib untuk Google OAuth 2.0).

---

## Langkah 1 — Siapkan Library (`vendor/` atau Pemasangan Manual PHPMailer)

### Opsi A — Menggunakan Composer (SSH / Komputer Lokal)
```bash
cd ~/public_html/mail/support
composer require google/apiclient:^2.18 phpmailer/phpmailer:^6.9
```
Atau jalankan di folder `support-septian/` lokal Anda:
```bash
composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader
```
Folder `mail/support/vendor/` akan terbentuk berisi `google/apiclient` dan `phpmailer/phpmailer`.

### Opsi B — Memasang PHPMailer Secara Manual (Tanpa Composer / cPanel File Manager)
1. Unduh rilis resmi PHPMailer dari GitHub (`https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/releases`).
2. Ekstrak arsip tersebut dan salin folder **`src/`** (berisi `Exception.php`, `PHPMailer.php`, dan `SMTP.php`) ke salah satu lokasi berikut:
   - `public_html/mail/support/includes/phpmailer/src/` *(Direkomendasikan — otomatis terlindungi `.htaccess`)*
   - `public_html/mail/support/vendor/phpmailer/phpmailer/src/`
3. `includes/config.php` akan otomatis mendeteksi dan memuat PHPMailer secara langsung tanpa memerlukan `vendor/autoload.php`.

---

## Langkah 2 — Buat Database MySQL di cPanel

1. Buka **MySQL® Databases** di cPanel.
2. Buat database baru (misalnya `septianf_support`).
3. Buat user database baru dengan kata sandi kuat.
4. Tambahkan user tersebut ke database dengan hak akses **ALL PRIVILEGES**.
5. *(Opsional jika tidak memakai auto-import di `install.php`)*: Impor file `database.sql` melalui **phpMyAdmin**.

---

## Langkah 3 — Unggah File ke `public_html/mail/support/`

Struktur akhir di server hosting:
```
/home/username/
├── support-septian-private/        <-- (Disarankan) Pindahkan config.php ke sini setelah instalasi
│   └── config.php                  (chmod 0600)
└── public_html/
    ├── logo.png                    (https://septianfr.web.id/logo.png)
    └── mail/
        └── support/
            ├── .htaccess
            ├── index.php
            ├── login.php
            ├── logout.php
            ├── dashboard.php
            ├── inbox.php
            ├── sent.php
            ├── drafts.php
            ├── starred.php
            ├── spam.php
            ├── trash.php
            ├── compose.php
            ├── view-email.php
            ├── templates.php
            ├── template-preview.php
            ├── gmail-connection.php
            ├── settings.php
            ├── profile.php
            ├── security.php
            ├── install.php
            ├── oauth/
            │   ├── connect.php
            │   ├── callback.php    <-- URL: https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support/oauth/callback.php
            │   └── disconnect.php
            ├── api/
            ├── assets/
            ├── includes/
            ├── storage/            (chmod 0750)
            │   ├── tokens/         (chmod 0750)
            │   └── logs/           (chmod 0750)
            ├── templates/
            └── vendor/             (hasil Composer)
```

Pastikan `database.sql` berada di `public_html/mail/support/database.sql` saat menjalankan `install.php`.

---

## Langkah 4 — Jalankan Instalasi Web

1. Kunjungi `https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support/install.php`.
2. Pastikan seluruh item pada bagian **Pemeriksaan Lingkungan Server PHP** berstatus **Siap**.
3. Isi detail database MySQL, akun admin pertama, identitas Support Septian F. R., dan kredensial OAuth / App Password.
4. Klik **Selesaikan Instalasi Support Septian**.

---

## Langkah 5 — Hardening Keamanan Pasca-Instalasi (Wajib)

1. **Pindahkan File Konfigurasi ke Luar `public_html`** (jika hosting mengizinkan akses direktori home):
   - Buat folder `/home/username/support-septian-private/` (`chmod 0700`).
   - Pindahkan `public_html/mail/support/storage/app-config.php` menjadi `/home/username/support-septian-private/config.php` (`chmod 0600`).
   - `includes/config.php` otomatis mendeteksi lokasi tersebut terlebih dahulu.
2. **Hapus File Instalasi**:
   - Hapus `public_html/mail/support/install.php` dan `public_html/mail/support/database.sql` setelah instalasi sukses.
3. **Verifikasi Proteksi `.htaccess`**:
   - Buka `https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support/includes/config.php` → harus mengembalikan **403 Forbidden**.
   - Buka `https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support/storage/tokens/` → harus mengembalikan **403 Forbidden**.
4. **Hubungkan Gmail & Verifikasi DKIM**:
   - Login ke `https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support/login.php`.
   - Buka menu **Koneksi Gmail**, hubungkan akun `support.septianfr@gmail.com` via OAuth 2.0 atau masukkan Google App Password 16 digit (PHPMailer `smtp.gmail.com:465` SSL, `SMTPAuth=true`).
   - Klik **Jalankan Diagnostik SMTP**, lalu kirim **1 Email Tes** ke alamat Gmail lain milik admin dan pastikan di Gmail penerima menu **Show Original** menunjukkan **`DKIM: PASS`**.

files.content:
# Support Septian — Aplikasi Manajemen Email Customer Support (PHP 8.1+ & MySQL PDO)

Aplikasi web manajemen email resmi untuk **Support Septian F. R.** yang terhubung langsung ke akun Gmail **`support.septianfr@gmail.com`**, dibangun murni menggunakan **HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript Vanilla, PHP 8.1+, dan MySQL PDO** tanpa React, TypeScript, Node.js, maupun proses kompilasi frontend.

---

## Identitas Resmi Aplikasi

| Komponen | Nilai |
| --- | --- |
| **Nama Aplikasi** | Support Septian |
| **Identitas Resmi** | Support Septian F. R. |
| **Email Gmail Resmi** | `support.septianfr@gmail.com` |
| **Website** | `https://septianfr.web.id` |
| **URL Aplikasi** | `https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support` |
| **OAuth Callback URI** | `https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support/oauth/callback.php` |
| **Logo Resmi** | `https://septianfr.web.id/logo.png` |
| **Alamat Lengkap** | H4GM+4XX, Jl. PUK Muntur, Ranjeng, Kec. Losarang, Kabupaten Indramayu, Jawa Barat 45253 |

---

## Fitur Utama

1. **Integrasi Gmail Sungguhan (Dual Mode)**:
   - **Google Gmail API (OAuth 2.0 Web Application)** menggunakan `google/apiclient`, dengan verifikasi `state` anti-CSRF, auto-refresh token, deteksi token dicabut, serta validasi ketat bahwa akun yang terhubung wajib `support.septianfr@gmail.com`.
   - **Google App Password (PHPMailer SMTP SSL:465 + IMAP)** menggunakan `phpmailer/phpmailer` ke `smtp.gmail.com:465` (`ENCRYPTION_SMTPS`, `SMTPAuth = true`) dengan identitas `Support Septian F. R. <support.septianfr@gmail.com>` sehingga penandatanganan DKIM dikelola resmi oleh server Google (`DKIM=PASS`), lengkap dengan **Panel Diagnostik SMTP** & tombol **Kirim 1 Email Tes**.
2. **Fitur Email Lengkap**:
   - Kotak Masuk (Inbox), Terkirim (Sent), Draft, Berbintang (Starred), Spam, Sampah (Trash).
   - Membaca thread percakapan lengkap dengan sanitasi HTML anti-XSS.
   - Balas Pesan (Reply), Balas Semua (Reply All), Kirim Baru (Compose), Teruskan (Forward), Simpan Draft.
   - Aksi massal & tunggal: Tandai Sudah/Belum Dibaca, Bintang, Arsip, Spam, Sampah, Hapus Permanen.
   - Pencarian email lintas folder, pagination Gmail, serta unggah & unduh lampiran tervalidasi.
3. **Sistem Template Email Profesional (Gaya Google)**:
   - 8+ template siap pakai (Balasan Standar, Konfirmasi Penerimaan Pesan, Informasi Sedang Diproses, Permintaan Informasi Tambahan, Penyelesaian Masalah, Ucapan Terima Kasih, Balasan Umum, Pesan Baru, dan Draft).
   - HTML inline CSS lebar 600px, background putih, logo & footer identitas resmi Support Septian F. R., responsif di Android, iPhone, dan Desktop.
   - Variabel dinamis: `{nama_penerima}`, `{email_penerima}`, `{subjek}`, `{tanggal}`, `{nama_pengirim}`, `{isi_pesan}`, `{nama_perusahaan}`, `{website}`, `{email_support}`.
4. **Keamanan Standar Produksi**:
   - `password_hash()` & `password_verify()`, session cookie aman (`HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Lax`, `Secure`), CSRF token pada seluruh form & API, PDO prepared statements (`ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false`), rate limiting login, enkripsi AES-256-GCM untuk Client Secret, OAuth Token, & App Password, `.htaccess` pemblokir direktori sensitif, serta modal konfirmasi wajib sebelum mengirim email.

---

## Instalasi Cepat

### 1. Instalasi Library Google API PHP Client & PHPMailer (Composer)
Jalankan perintah berikut di folder root paket `support-septian/`:

```bash
composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader
```

Perintah tersebut otomatis memasang `google/apiclient` dan `phpmailer/phpmailer` ke dalam `mail/support/vendor/` serta membersihkan service Google selain `Gmail` & `Oauth2` agar ukuran folder `vendor/` tetap ringan saat diunggah ke shared hosting.

### 2. Unggah ke Hosting PHP
Unggah isi folder `mail/support/` ke direktori:
```
public_html/mail/support/
```
*(Sertakan folder `mail/support/vendor/` hasil Composer serta salin `database.sql` ke `public_html/mail/support/database.sql` selama instalasi, lalu hapus file `database.sql` & `install.php` setelah selesai).*

### 3. Jalankan Web Installer
Buka browser dan akses:
```
https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support/install.php
```
Isi:
1. Koneksi MySQL (host, nama database, username, password).
2. Akun administrator pertama.
3. Identitas resmi Support Septian F. R.
4. Kredensial Google OAuth 2.0 (Client ID & Secret) dan/atau Google App Password 16 digit.

### 4. Konfigurasi Google Cloud Console (Untuk OAuth 2.0)
1. Buka [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/) → buat/pilih proyek.
2. Aktifkan **Gmail API**.
3. Konfigurasikan **OAuth Consent Screen** (External/Internal), tambahkan scopes:
   - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly`
   - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send`
   - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify`
   Tambahkan `support.septianfr@gmail.com` pada **Test Users** bila aplikasi masih dalam status Testing.
4. Buat **OAuth Client ID** dengan tipe **Web Application**:
   - **Authorized JavaScript origins**: `https://septianfr.web.id`
   - **Authorized redirect URIs**: `https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support/oauth/callback.php`
5. Masukkan Client ID dan Client Secret pada halaman **Koneksi Gmail**, lalu klik **Hubungkan Gmail**.

### 5. Alternatif: Konfigurasi Google App Password (PHPMailer SMTP SSL:465)
1. Buka akun Google `support.septianfr@gmail.com` → **Security** → aktifkan **2-Step Verification**.
2. Buka menu **App Passwords**, buat sandi aplikasi bernama `Support Septian`.
3. Masuk ke halaman **Koneksi Gmail** di aplikasi Support Septian, masukkan 16 karakter App Password tersebut, klik **Jalankan Diagnostik SMTP & IMAP**, lalu simpan & aktifkan.
4. Gunakan panel **Tes Pengiriman Email (1 Email Percobaan)** untuk mengirim 1 email tes ke Gmail admin lain, lalu periksa **Show Original (Tampilkan Asli)** di Gmail penerima untuk memastikan `Authentication-Results` menampilkan `DKIM=PASS`.

Lihat `DEPLOYMENT.md` untuk panduan lengkap deployment pada cPanel / Shared Hosting PHP.

Tabel activity_logs -- Audit log aktivitas admin, pengiriman email, perubahan konfigurasi, & keamanan -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `activity_logs` ( `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `admin_id` INT UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL, `action` VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, `entity_type` VARCHAR(60) DEFAULT NULL, `entity_id` VARCHAR(160) DEFAULT NULL, `description` VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, `ip_address` VARCHAR(45) DEFAULT NULL, `user_agent` VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL, `status` ENUM('success', 'warning', 'error') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'success', `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `idx_activity_admin` (`admin_id`, `created_at`), KEY `idx_activity_action` (`action`, `created_at`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci; -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- 6. # ============================================================================
# SUPPORT SEPTIAN — Apache .htaccess Security & Routing
# Path: /mail/support/.htaccess
# ============================================================================

# Matikan listing direktori (aman untuk sebagian besar cPanel / LiteSpeed)
<IfModule mod_autoindex.c>
    Options -Indexes
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
    RewriteEngine On

    # Paksa HTTPS di produksi (nonaktifkan hanya saat testing lokal)
    RewriteCond %{HTTPS} !=on
    RewriteCond %{HTTP:X-Forwarded-Proto} !https [NC]
    RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} !^localhost [NC]
    RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} !^127\.0\.0\.1 [NC]
    RewriteRule ^ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [L,R=301]

    # Blokir akses langsung ke folder internal sensitif
    RewriteRule ^includes/ - [F,L]
    RewriteRule ^storage/ - [F,L]
    RewriteRule ^vendor/ - [F,L]
    RewriteRule ^templates/ - [F,L]
</IfModule>

# Blokir akses langsung ke file sensitif dan konfigurasi
<FilesMatch "(^\.htaccess|^\.env|composer\.(json|lock)|database\.sql|config\.php|config\.sample\.php|\.log$|\.json$)">
    <IfModule mod_authz_core.c>
        Require all denied
    </IfModule>
    <IfModule !mod_authz_core.c>
        Order allow,deny
        Deny from all
    </IfModule>
</FilesMatch>

# Header keamanan HTTP
<IfModule mod_headers.c>
    Header always set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
    Header always set X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN"
    Header always set Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
    Header always set Permissions-Policy "geolocation=(), microphone=(), camera=()"
</IfModule>

# Batasi ukuran upload sesuai standar lampiran email (25MB)
<IfModule mod_php.c>
    php_value upload_max_filesize 25M
    php_value post_max_size 30M
    php_flag display_errors Off
    php_flag log_errors On
</IfModule>

-- ============================================================================ -- SKYZZ MAIL — DATABASE SCHEMA (MySQL 8.0+ / MariaDB 10.4+) -- Platform Layanan Email Multi-User, Sewa Email, API Pengiriman & Pembayaran QRIS -- ============================================================================ SET NAMES utf8mb4; SET time_zone = '+07:00'; SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS = 0; -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- 1. Tabel admins (Menyimpan akun Superadmin dan User terdaftar) -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `admins` ( `id` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `name` VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, `email` VARCHAR(190) NOT NULL, `username` VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, `password_hash` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, `role` ENUM('superadmin', 'admin', 'user') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', `job_title` VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Pengguna Skyzz Mail', `avatar_url` VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL, `selected_mailbox_id` INT UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL, `plan_slug` VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'free', `plan_expires_at` DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, `custom_sender_name` VARCHAR(120) DEFAULT NULL, `custom_signature` MEDIUMTEXT DEFAULT NULL, `custom_footer_note` VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL, `is_active` TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `last_login_at` DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, `last_login_ip` VARCHAR(45) DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_admins_email` (`email`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_admins_username` (`username`), KEY `idx_admins_role` (`role`), KEY `idx_admins_plan` (`plan_slug`, `plan_expires_at`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci; -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- 2. Tabel app_settings (Pengaturan global aplikasi, branding, QRIS, legal & kontak) -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `app_settings` ( `setting_key` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, `setting_value` MEDIUMTEXT DEFAULT NULL, `is_encrypted` TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `updated_by` INT UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL, `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`setting_key`), KEY `idx_app_settings_updated_by` (`updated_by`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci; -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- 3. Tabel mailboxes (Akun email yang dikonfigurasi Superadmin untuk dipilih User) -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mailboxes` ( `id` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `label` VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, `email` VARCHAR(190) NOT NULL, `display_name` VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, `provider_mode` ENUM('app_password', 'oauth') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'app_password', `smtp_host` VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'smtp.gmail.com', `smtp_port` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 465, `smtp_encryption` ENUM('ssl', 'tls', 'none') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ssl', `smtp_username` VARCHAR(190) NOT NULL, `smtp_password_enc` TEXT DEFAULT NULL, `imap_host` VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'imap.gmail.com', `imap_port` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 993, `is_active` TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `is_default` TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `allow_user_select` TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `created_by` INT UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_mailboxes_email` (`email`), KEY `idx_mailboxes_active` (`is_active`, `allow_user_select`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci; -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- 4. Tabel packages (Paket langganan Free, Lite, Pro, Business — dapat diubah Superadmin) -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `packages` ( `slug` VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, `name` VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, `price_monthly` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `daily_send_limit` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, `allow_api` TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `has_watermark` TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `watermark_text` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `description` VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL, `is_active` TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `sort_order` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`slug`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci; -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- 5. Tabel payment_orders (Pembayaran QRIS All Payment & verifikasi manual Superadmin) -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `payment_orders` ( `id` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `order_code` VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, `user_id` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, `package_slug` VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, `duration_months` TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `amount_total` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `proof_image_path` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, `payer_note` VARCHAR(300) DEFAULT NULL, `status` ENUM('pending', 'approved', 'rejected') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', `admin_note` VARCHAR(300) DEFAULT NULL, `reviewed_by` INT UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL, `reviewed_at` DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_payment_order_code` (`order_code`), KEY `idx_payment_user` (`user_id`, `created_at`), KEY `idx_payment_status` (`status`, `created_at`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci; -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- 6. Peringatan Sebelum Menghapus Akun

Anda sedang masuk sebagai ( · ). Menghapus akun akan menghapus secara permanen:

  • Akun login, profil, nama pengirim kustom, dan tanda tangan email Anda.
  • Seluruh API Key pengiriman yang terhubung dengan akun Anda.
  • Seluruh template email kustom pribadi milik Anda.
  • Riwayat pembayaran QRIS beserta file foto bukti transfer yang pernah Anda unggah.

Privacy Policy (Kebijakan Privasi)

Kebijakan Privasi ini menjelaskan bagaimana yang dikelola oleh mengumpulkan, menggunakan, menyimpan, dan melindungi informasi pribadi pengguna saat menggunakan layanan web, aplikasi mobile, maupun REST API pengiriman email.

1. Data yang Kami Kumpulkan

  • Data Akun: Nama lengkap, username, alamat email pendaftaran, kata sandi (disimpan secara terenkripsi satu arah menggunakan password_hash), serta pilihan akun email layanan.
  • Data Penggunaan Email & Kuota: Metadata pengiriman (alamat pengirim, penerima, subjek, waktu kirim, status berhasil/gagal) untuk menghitung kuota harian dan menampilkan riwayat Terkirim.
  • Data Pembayaran QRIS: Bukti tangkapan layar/foto pembayaran, paket yang dipilih, durasi langganan, dan catatan pembayaran yang Anda unggah secara sukarela untuk verifikasi manual.
  • Data Teknis Keamanan: Alamat IP saat login, jenis browser (User-Agent), dan log aktivitas untuk mencegah penyalahgunaan atau percobaan login tidak sah.

2. Cara Kami Menggunakan Data

  • Menyediakan layanan penerimaan pesan tanpa batas dan pengiriman pesan sesuai paket aktif (Free, Lite, Pro, Business).
  • Mengautentikasi akses API pengiriman email menggunakan API Key ter-hash (SHA-256).
  • Memverifikasi pembayaran upgrade paket QRIS secara manual oleh Superadmin.
  • Mencegah spam, phishing, brute-force login, dan menjaga keamanan infrastruktur email.

3. Keamanan & Enkripsi

Kredensial SMTP/IMAP dan token OAuth dienkripsi di server menggunakan AES-256-GCM. Kami tidak pernah menjual, menyewakan, atau memperdagangkan data pribadi pengguna kepada pihak ketiga mana pun.

4. Hak Pengguna & Penghapusan Data

Anda berhak memperbarui profil atau menghapus akun beserta seluruh data Anda secara permanen kapan saja melalui tombol Hapus Akun di dalam aplikasi.

Terms & Conditions (Syarat & Ketentuan Penggunaan)

Dengan mendaftar, mengakses, atau menggunakan layanan , Anda menyetujui seluruh syarat dan ketentuan berikut:

1. Akun & Peran Pengguna

  • Setiap pengguna bertanggung jawab penuh atas kerahasiaan kata sandi dan API Key miliknya.
  • Pengguna dapat memilih alamat email layanan yang disediakan dan dikonfigurasi oleh Superadmin.
  • Pengguna reguler hanya memiliki akses untuk membaca, mengirim, mengelola template kustom, menghapus pesan, menggunakan API, mengelola paket, dan menghapus akun miliknya sendiri.

2. Paket Layanan & Kuota Harian

  • Free (Gratis Selamanya): Maksimal 10 pengiriman email per hari, terima pesan tanpa batas, mendukung API pengiriman, dan menyertakan watermark “Dikirim Menggunakan Aplikasi Skyzz Mail”.
  • Lite, Pro, & Business (Berbayar): Peningkatan kuota pengiriman harian (50 / 100 / 200 email per hari sesuai ketentuan harga yang ditetapkan Superadmin), bebas watermark, serta mendukung API pengiriman.
  • Durasi pembelian paket berbayar adalah minimal 1 bulan dan maksimal 12 bulan (1 tahun). Setelah masa aktif berakhir, akun secara otomatis kembali ke paket Free tanpa menghapus akun.
  • Pengiriman email yang gagal akibat gangguan jaringan/server tidak mengurangi kuota harian Anda.

3. Penangguhan & Penghentian

Superadmin berhak menangguhkan atau menghapus akun yang terbukti melanggar Acceptable Use Policy (seperti pengiriman spam massal, penipuan, atau phishing) tanpa pemberitahuan sebelumnya.

Disclaimer (Batas Tanggung Jawab Layanan)

Layanan disediakan sebagaimana adanya (“as is” dan “as available”).

  • Kami berupaya semaksimal mungkin menjaga keandalan pengiriman SMTP/Gmail API dan ketersediaan server, namun kami tidak menjamin layanan 100% bebas gangguan di luar kendali kami (seperti kebijakan pembatasan Google/Gmail, gangguan ISP, atau server penerima).
  • Seluruh isi pesan, lampiran, dan template kustom yang dikirim melalui akun pengguna sepenuhnya menjadi tanggung jawab hukum masing-masing pengguna.
  • tidak bertanggung jawab atas kerugian tidak langsung, kehilangan data pihak ketiga, atau penolakan email oleh filter spam penyedia email tujuan.

Refund Policy (Kebijakan Pengembalian Dana)

Kebijakan ini mengatur ketentuan pengembalian dana untuk pembelian paket berbayar (Lite, Pro, Business) melalui QRIS All Payment di :

  • Sebelum Konfirmasi Admin: Jika Anda melakukan kesalahan nominal transfer atau pesanan ditolak oleh Admin karena ketidaksesuaian bukti, Anda dapat menghubungi tim dukungan dalam waktu 3x24 jam untuk verifikasi atau penyesuaian.
  • Setelah Paket Aktif: Paket langganan digital yang telah disetujui dan diaktifkan pada akun Anda bersifat tidak dapat dikembalikan (non-refundable), kecuali terjadi kegagalan sistem total dari sisi server kami selama lebih dari 72 jam berturut-turut.
  • Pelanggaran AUP: Akun yang dinonaktifkan karena pelanggaran spam, phishing, atau penyalahgunaan layanan tidak berhak mendapatkan pengembalian dana.
  • Untuk mengajukan peninjauan pengembalian dana, sertakan Kode Pesanan (SKZ-...) dan bukti transfer ke .

Acceptable Use Policy (Kebijakan Penggunaan yang Dapat Diterima)

Demi menjaga reputasi IP, skor DKIM/SPF, dan keamanan seluruh pengguna , setiap pengguna DILARANG KERAS menggunakan layanan maupun API untuk:

  • Spam & Email Massal Tanpa Izin: Mengirim promosi berulang kepada penerima yang tidak memberikan persetujuan (unsolicited bulk email).
  • Phishing & Penipuan: Menyamarkan identitas untuk mencuri kata sandi, OTP, data perbankan, akun media sosial, atau informasi sensitif lainnya.
  • Malware & Konten Berbahaya: Melampirkan virus, trojan, skrip berbahaya, atau tautan situs penipuan.
  • Ujaran Kebencian, Ancaman, & Konten Ilegal: Mengirim materi yang melanggar hukum Republik Indonesia maupun peraturan internasional.
  • Penyalahgunaan Kuota & Pembuatan Banyak Akun Palsu: Mengakali batas pengiriman harian dengan membuat banyak akun otomatis (bot).

Pelanggaran terhadap kebijakan ini akan berakibat pada pencabutan API Key, penangguhan permanen akun, dan pelaporan kepada pihak berwenang apabila diperlukan.

Data Safety (Deklarasi Keamanan Data — Google Play Console)

Bagian ini disusun transparan untuk memenuhi standar deklarasi Google Play Console Data Safety bagi pengguna web maupun aplikasi Android :

Kategori Data Dikumpulkan? Dibagikan ke Pihak Ketiga? Tujuan
Info Pribadi (Nama, Username, Email) Ya Tidak Fungsi aplikasi, manajemen akun, autentikasi login
Pesan & Log Email (Metadata kirim/terima) Ya Tidak (hanya dikirim ke server email tujuan sesuai permintaan pengguna) Fungsi utama pengiriman/penerimaan email & kuota harian
Foto / File Unggahan (Bukti QRIS & Lampiran) Opsional (saat pengguna mengunggah) Tidak Verifikasi upgrade paket & pengiriman lampiran email
Keamanan & Log Diagnostik (IP Login, Error Log) Ya Tidak Pencegahan brute-force, keamanan akun, & stabilitas server
  • Enkripsi dalam Transit: Seluruh komunikasi menggunakan HTTPS/TLS dan SMTP/IMAP terenkripsi (SSL/TLS).
  • Penghapusan Data: Pengguna dapat menghapus akun dan seluruh data pribadinya secara mandiri dan permanen melalui halaman Hapus Akun.

Account Deletion Policy (Kebijakan Penghapusan Akun & Data)

Sesuai kebijakan privasi dan persyaratan Google Play Console, setiap pengguna memiliki kontrol penuh untuk menghapus akun dan seluruh data pribadinya kapan saja.

1. Cara Menghapus Akun Secara Mandiri (Instan)

  1. Masuk ke akun Anda (baik di Desktop maupun di HP Android / Layar Mini).
  2. Klik tombol “Hapus Akun” di menu navigasi sidebar, di halaman Profil & Pengirim, atau di footer bawah halaman.
  3. Masukkan kata sandi akun Anda untuk konfirmasi keamanan, centang kotak persetujuan, lalu klik “Hapus Akun Secara Permanen”.

2. Data yang Dihapus Secara Permanen

  • Data profil akun (nama, username, email, kata sandi ter-hash, tanda tangan kustom).
  • Seluruh API Key pengiriman milik akun Anda.
  • Seluruh template email kustom pribadi milik akun Anda.
  • Riwayat pesanan pembayaran beserta file foto/screenshot bukti pembayaran QRIS yang pernah diunggah.
  • Log aktivitas dan riwayat pengiriman lokal milik akun Anda.

3. Permintaan Penghapusan Tanpa Login

Apabila Anda lupa kata sandi dan tidak dapat masuk ke aplikasi, Anda dapat mengirim permintaan penghapusan akun dari email terdaftar Anda ke dengan subjek Permintaan Hapus Akun . Proses penghapusan akan diselesaikan maksimal dalam 7 hari kerja.

<?php
/**
 * Support Septian — API: Message Actions (Read, Unread, Star, Archive, Spam, Trash, Delete)
 * POST /mail/support/api/actions.php
 * Body JSON: { "action": "mark_read|mark_unread|star|unstar|archive|trash|untrash|spam|not_spam|delete", "ids": ["..."] }
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/auth.php';
require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/gmail-service.php';

require_admin(true);

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
    json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Metode tidak diizinkan.'], 405);
}

$data = !empty($_POST) ? $_POST : read_json_input();
require_csrf(true);

$action = trim((string) ($data['action'] ?? ''));
$ids    = $data['ids'] ?? [];
if (is_string($ids)) {
    $ids = [$ids];
}

$allowedActions = ['mark_read', 'mark_unread', 'star', 'unstar', 'archive', 'trash', 'untrash', 'spam', 'not_spam', 'delete'];
if (!in_array($action, $allowedActions, true) || !is_array($ids) || empty($ids)) {
    json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Aksi atau daftar pesan tidak valid.'], 422);
}

try {
    $processed = 0;
    foreach ($ids as $msgId) {
        $cleanId = trim((string) $msgId);
        if ($cleanId === '') {
            continue;
        }
        mail_perform_message_action($cleanId, $action);
        $processed++;
    }

    $labels = [
        'mark_read'   => 'Ditandai sudah dibaca.',
        'mark_unread' => 'Ditandai belum dibaca.',
        'star'        => 'Ditambahkan tanda bintang.',
        'unstar'      => 'Tanda bintang dihapus.',
        'archive'     => 'Email dipindahkan ke arsip.',
        'trash'       => 'Email dipindahkan ke sampah.',
        'untrash'     => 'Email dipulihkan dari sampah.',
        'spam'        => 'Email dilaporkan sebagai spam.',
        'not_spam'    => 'Email dipindahkan kembali ke kotak masuk.',
        'delete'      => 'Email dihapus permanen.',
    ];

    json_response([
        'ok'        => true,
        'processed' => $processed,
        'message'   => $labels[$action] ?? 'Aksi berhasil dijalankan.',
    ]);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    app_log('error', 'API actions.php error: ' . $e->getMessage());
    json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()], 400);
}

<?php
/**
 * Support Septian — API: Secure Attachment Download
 * GET /mail/support/api/attachments.php?message_id=...&attachment_id=...&filename=...
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/auth.php';
require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/gmail-service.php';

require_admin(false);

$messageId    = trim((string) ($_GET['message_id'] ?? ''));
$attachmentId = trim((string) ($_GET['attachment_id'] ?? ''));
$filename     = trim((string) ($_GET['filename'] ?? 'lampiran'));

if ($messageId === '' || $attachmentId === '') {
    http_response_code(400);
    exit('Parameter lampiran tidak lengkap.');
}

try {
    $file = mail_download_attachment($messageId, $attachmentId, $filename);
    $safeName = preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9._\- ]/', '_', basename($file['filename'])) ?: 'lampiran';

    header('Content-Type: application/octet-stream');
    header('Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="' . $safeName . '"');
    header('Content-Length: ' . strlen($file['data']));
    header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');
    header('Cache-Control: private, no-store');

    echo $file['data'];
    exit;
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    app_log('error', 'API attachments.php error: ' . $e->getMessage());
    http_response_code(500);
    exit('Gagal mengunduh lampiran: ' . e($e->getMessage()));
}

if (empty($data['confirmed']) || (string) $data['confirmed'] !== '1') {
    json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Konfirmasi admin wajib dilakukan sebelum meneruskan email.'], 422);
}

try {

    $recipientName = trim((string) ($data['recipient_name'] ?? ''));

    if ($subject !== '' && !preg_match('/^fwd:/i', $subject)) {
        $subject = 'Fwd: ' . $subject;
    }

    $result = mail_send_email([
        'to'            => $to,
        'cc'            => $cc,
        'subject'       => $subject,
        'body_html'     => $bodyHtml,
        'quoted_html'   => $quotedHtml,
        'wrap_template' => true,
        'attachments'   => $attachments,

            'subjek'        => (string) (preg_replace('/^fwd:\s*/i', '', $subject) ?? $subject),
        ],
    ]);

    json_response([
        'ok'      => true,
        'message' => 'Email berhasil diteruskan.',
        'result'  => $result,

} catch (Throwable $e) {

}

/**
 * Skyzz Mail — Authenticated & Path-Confined Media Server
 * GET /mail/support/api/media.php?type=qris
 * GET /mail/support/api/media.php?type=proof&id=<payment_order_id>
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/auth.php';

$user = require_admin(false);
$type = strtolower(trim((string) ($_GET['type'] ?? '')));

$uploadsRoot = defined('UPLOADS_PATH') ? UPLOADS_PATH : (STORAGE_PATH . '/uploads');
$realRoot    = realpath($uploadsRoot);
if ($realRoot === false) {
    http_response_code(404);
    exit('Media tidak ditemukan.');
}

$relPath = '';

if ($type === 'qris') {
    $relPath = ltrim(trim(get_setting('qris_image_path', '')), '/');
    if ($relPath === '' || !str_starts_with($relPath, 'qris/')) {
        http_response_code(404);
        exit('Gambar QRIS belum diunggah.');
    }
} elseif ($type === 'proof') {
    $orderId = (int) ($_GET['id'] ?? 0);
    if ($orderId <= 0) {
        http_response_code(400);
        exit('ID pesanan tidak valid.');
    }
    $stmt = db()->prepare('SELECT user_id, proof_image_path FROM payment_orders WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1');
    $stmt->execute([':id' => $orderId]);
    $order = $stmt->fetch();
    if (!$order) {
        http_response_code(404);
        exit('Bukti pembayaran tidak ditemukan.');
    }
    if (!is_superadmin($user) && (int) $order['user_id'] !== (int) $user['id']) {
        http_response_code(403);
        exit('Akses ditolak.');
    }
    $relPath = ltrim(trim((string) ($order['proof_image_path'] ?? '')), '/');
    if ($relPath === '' || !str_starts_with($relPath, 'proofs/')) {
        http_response_code(404);
        exit('File bukti pembayaran tidak ditemukan.');
    }
} else {
    http_response_code(400);
    exit('Tipe media tidak valid.');
}

// Konfinemen path ketat: hanya boleh subdirektori + basename tanpa traversal
$parts = explode('/', $relPath, 2);
if (count($parts) !== 2) {
    http_response_code(403);
    exit('Path media tidak valid.');
}
$safeSub  = $parts[0];
$safeName = basename($parts[1]);
$candidate = realpath($uploadsRoot . '/' . $safeSub . '/' . $safeName);

if (
    $candidate === false
    || !str_starts_with($candidate, $realRoot . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR)
    || !is_file($candidate)
    || !is_readable($candidate)
) {
    http_response_code(404);
    exit('File media tidak ditemukan.');
}

$ext = strtolower(pathinfo($candidate, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
$mimeMap = [
    'jpg'  => 'image/jpeg',
    'jpeg' => 'image/jpeg',
    'png'  => 'image/png',
    'webp' => 'image/webp',
];
$mime = $mimeMap[$ext] ?? 'application/octet-stream';

header('Content-Type: ' . $mime);
header('Content-Length: ' . (string) filesize($candidate));
header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');
header('Cache-Control: private, max-age=300');
readfile($candidate);
exit;

<?php
/**
 * Skyzz Mail — API: Messages, Thread Detail & Mailbox Stats (dengan Cache & Force Refresh)
 * GET /mail/support/api/messages.php
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/auth.php';
require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/gmail-service.php';

$user = require_admin(true);

try {
    $force = (string) ($_GET['force'] ?? '') === '1';

    if (!empty($_GET['stats'])) {
        $status = get_mail_connection_status();
        $quota  = get_user_quota_status($user);

        if (!$status['active_ready']) {
            json_response([
                'ok'         => false,
                'code'       => 'NOT_CONNECTED',
                'message'    => $status['notice'] ?: 'Akun email belum dikonfigurasi.',
                'connection' => $status,
                'quota'      => $quota,
            ], 200);
        }

        $stats = mail_get_dashboard_stats($force);
        json_response([
            'ok'         => true,
            'stats'      => $stats,
            'connection' => $status,
            'quota'      => $quota,
        ]);
    }

    if (!empty($_GET['id'])) {
        $messageId = trim((string) $_GET['id']);
        $thread = mail_get_thread_detail($messageId, true);
        json_response([
            'ok'     => true,
            'thread' => $thread,
        ]);
    }

    $allowedFolders = ['inbox', 'sent', 'drafts', 'starred', 'spam', 'trash', 'all'];
    $folder = strtolower(trim((string) ($_GET['folder'] ?? 'inbox')));
    if (!in_array($folder, $allowedFolders, true)) {
        $folder = 'inbox';
    }

    $limit     = (int) ($_GET['limit'] ?? get_setting('items_per_page', '20'));
    $pageToken = isset($_GET['pageToken']) && $_GET['pageToken'] !== '' ? trim((string) $_GET['pageToken']) : null;
    $q         = trim((string) ($_GET['q'] ?? ''));

    $result = mail_list_messages($folder, $limit, $pageToken, $q, $force);

    json_response([
        'ok'              => true,
        'folder'          => $folder,
        'messages'        => $result['messages'],
        'next_page_token' => $result['next_page_token'],
        'result_estimate' => $result['result_estimate'],
        'transport'       => $result['transport'],
        'from_cache'      => !empty($result['from_cache']),
        'notice'          => $result['notice'] ?? null,
    ]);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    app_log('error', 'API messages.php error: ' . $e->getMessage());
    json_response([
        'ok'      => false,
        'message' => $e->getMessage(),
    ], 400);
}

<?php
/**
 * Support Septian — API: Reply All Email
 * POST /mail/support/api/reply-all.php
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/auth.php';
require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/gmail-service.php';

$admin = require_admin(true);

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
    json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Metode tidak diizinkan.'], 405);
}

$data = !empty($_POST) ? $_POST : read_json_input();
require_csrf(true);

if (empty($data['confirmed']) || (string) $data['confirmed'] !== '1') {
    json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Konfirmasi admin wajib dilakukan sebelum mengirim Balas Semua.'], 422);
}

try {
    $attachments   = !empty($_FILES['attachments']) ? validate_uploaded_attachments($_FILES['attachments']) : [];
    $officialEmail = strtolower(trim(get_setting('support_email', DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_GMAIL)));

    $toList = array_values(array_filter(
        parse_email_list((string) ($data['to'] ?? '')),
        static fn(string $email): bool => $email !== $officialEmail
    ));
    $ccList = array_values(array_filter(
        parse_email_list((string) ($data['cc'] ?? '')),
        static fn(string $email): bool => $email !== $officialEmail && !in_array($email, $toList, true)
    ));

    if (empty($toList)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Daftar penerima Balas Semua kosong.');
    }

    $subject       = trim((string) ($data['subject'] ?? ''));
    $bodyHtml      = (string) ($data['body_html'] ?? '');
    $quotedHtml    = (string) ($data['quoted_html'] ?? '');
    $threadId      = trim((string) ($data['thread_id'] ?? ''));
    $inReplyTo     = trim((string) ($data['in_reply_to'] ?? ''));
    $references    = trim((string) ($data['references'] ?? ''));
    $recipientName = trim((string) ($data['recipient_name'] ?? ''));

    if ($subject !== '' && !preg_match('/^re:/i', $subject)) {
        $subject = 'Re: ' . $subject;
    }

    $result = mail_send_email([
        'to'            => implode(', ', $toList),
        'cc'            => implode(', ', $ccList),
        'subject'       => $subject,
        'body_html'     => $bodyHtml,
        'quoted_html'   => $quotedHtml,
        'wrap_template' => true,
        'thread_id'     => $threadId,
        'in_reply_to'   => $inReplyTo,
        'references'    => trim($references . ' ' . $inReplyTo),
        'attachments'   => $attachments,
        'variables'     => [
            'nama_penerima' => $recipientName !== '' ? $recipientName : 'Bapak/Ibu',
            'nama_pengirim' => $admin['name'] ?: DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_NAME,
            'subjek'        => (string) (preg_replace('/^re:\s*/i', '', $subject) ?? $subject),
        ],
    ]);

    json_response([
        'ok'      => true,
        'message' => 'Balasan ke semua penerima (Reply All) berhasil dikirim.',
        'result'  => $result,
    ]);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    app_log('error', 'API reply-all.php error: ' . $e->getMessage());
    json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()], 400);
}

<?php
/**
 * Skyzz Mail — API: Custom Email Templates CRUD & Live Preview Renderer
 * GET  /mail/support/api/templates.php?category=reply|compose|...&id=...
 * POST /mail/support/api/templates.php (action: create | update | delete | duplicate | set_default | preview)
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/auth.php';
require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/email-renderer.php';

$user    = require_admin(true);
$isSuper = is_superadmin($user);
$uid     = (int) $user['id'];

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'GET') {
    try {
        if (!empty($_GET['id'])) {
            $stmt = db()->prepare('SELECT * FROM email_templates WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1');
            $stmt->execute([':id' => (int) $_GET['id']]);
            $tpl = $stmt->fetch();
            if (!$tpl) {
                json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Template tidak ditemukan.'], 404);
            }
            if (!$isSuper && $tpl['owner_id'] !== null && (int) $tpl['owner_id'] !== $uid) {
                json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.'], 403);
            }
            json_response(['ok' => true, 'template' => $tpl]);
        }

        $category = isset($_GET['category']) ? trim((string) $_GET['category']) : null;
        $list     = get_templates($category, $uid, $isSuper);
        json_response(['ok' => true, 'templates' => $list]);
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()], 400);
    }
}

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
    json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Metode tidak diizinkan.'], 405);
}

$data = !empty($_POST) ? $_POST : read_json_input();
require_csrf(true);

$action = trim((string) ($data['action'] ?? ''));
$allowedCategories = ['reply', 'reply_all', 'compose', 'forward', 'draft'];

try {
    switch ($action) {
        case 'preview':
            $bodyHtml = (string) ($data['body_html'] ?? '');
            $subject  = (string) ($data['subject'] ?? 'Contoh Subjek Skyzz Mail');
            $plan     = get_user_effective_plan($user);
            $mb       = get_effective_mailbox($user);
            $senderNm = trim((string) ($user['custom_sender_name'] ?? '')) ?: (string) ($mb['display_name'] ?? $user['name']);
            $vars     = [
                'nama_penerima'   => (string) ($data['nama_penerima'] ?? 'Budi Santoso'),
                'email_penerima'  => (string) ($data['email_penerima'] ?? 'budi@contoh.id'),
                'subjek'          => $subject,
                'nama_pengirim'   => $senderNm,
                'nama_perusahaan' => $senderNm,
                'email_support'   => (string) ($mb['email'] ?? DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_GMAIL),
                'isi_pesan'       => (string) ($data['isi_pesan'] ?? 'Terima kasih atas pesan Anda. Ini adalah contoh pratinjau template bebas kustom dari Skyzz Mail.'),
            ];
            $opts = [
                'sender_name'    => $senderNm,
                'sender_email'   => (string) ($mb['email'] ?? DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_GMAIL),
                'watermark_text' => !empty($plan['has_watermark']) ? ((string) ($plan['watermark_text'] ?: FREE_WATERMARK_DEFAULT)) : '',
            ];
            if (!empty($user['custom_signature'])) {
                $opts['signature'] = (string) $user['custom_signature'];
            }
            if (isset($user['custom_footer_note']) && trim((string) $user['custom_footer_note']) !== '') {
                $opts['footer_note'] = (string) $user['custom_footer_note'];
            }
            $renderedSubject = replace_template_variables($subject, $vars, false);
            $renderedHtml    = render_professional_email_html($bodyHtml, $renderedSubject, $vars, true, '', $opts);
            json_response([
                'ok'      => true,
                'subject' => $renderedSubject,
                'html'    => $renderedHtml,
            ]);

        case 'create':
            $name     = trim((string) ($data['name'] ?? ''));
            $category = trim((string) ($data['category'] ?? 'reply'));
            $subject  = trim((string) ($data['subject_template'] ?? ''));
            $bodyHtml = (string) ($data['body_html'] ?? '');
            $desc     = trim((string) ($data['description'] ?? ''));
            $isDef    = !empty($data['is_default']) ? 1 : 0;
            $ownerId  = $isSuper && !empty($data['is_global']) ? null : ($isSuper ? null : $uid);

            if ($name === '' || trim($bodyHtml) === '') {
                json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Nama template dan isi HTML wajib diisi.'], 422);
            }
            if (!in_array($category, $allowedCategories, true)) {
                $category = 'reply';
            }

            $slug = slugify($name) . '-' . substr(bin2hex(random_bytes(3)), 0, 6);
            $safeBody = sanitize_outgoing_body_html($bodyHtml);

            if ($isDef === 1) {
                if ($ownerId === null) {
                    $reset = db()->prepare('UPDATE email_templates SET is_default = 0 WHERE category = :cat AND owner_id IS NULL');
                    $reset->execute([':cat' => $category]);
                } else {
                    $reset = db()->prepare('UPDATE email_templates SET is_default = 0 WHERE category = :cat AND owner_id = :oid');
                    $reset->execute([':cat' => $category, ':oid' => $ownerId]);
                }
            }

            $stmt = db()->prepare(
                'INSERT INTO email_templates (owner_id, slug, name, category, subject_template, body_html, is_default, is_active, description, created_by, updated_by)
                 VALUES (:oid, :slug, :name, :cat, :subj, :body, :def, 1, :desc, :uid1, :uid2)'
            );
            $stmt->execute([
                ':oid'  => $ownerId,
                ':slug' => $slug,
                ':name' => $name,
                ':cat'  => $category,
                ':subj' => $subject,
                ':body' => $safeBody,
                ':def'  => $isDef,
                ':desc' => $desc,
                ':uid1' => $uid,
                ':uid2' => $uid,
            ]);
            $newId = (int) db()->lastInsertId();

            log_activity('template_created', 'Template email kustom dibuat: ' . $name, 'template', (string) $newId);
            json_response(['ok' => true, 'message' => 'Template kustom berhasil dibuat.', 'id' => $newId]);

        case 'update':
            $id       = (int) ($data['id'] ?? 0);
            $name     = trim((string) ($data['name'] ?? ''));
            $category = trim((string) ($data['category'] ?? 'reply'));
            $subject  = trim((string) ($data['subject_template'] ?? ''));
            $bodyHtml = (string) ($data['body_html'] ?? '');
            $desc     = trim((string) ($data['description'] ?? ''));
            $isDef    = !empty($data['is_default']) ? 1 : 0;

            if ($id <= 0 || $name === '' || trim($bodyHtml) === '') {
                json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Data template tidak lengkap.'], 422);
            }

            $chk = db()->prepare('SELECT id, owner_id FROM email_templates WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1');
            $chk->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $existing = $chk->fetch();
            if (!$existing) {
                json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Template tidak ditemukan.'], 404);
            }
            if (!$isSuper && (int) ($existing['owner_id'] ?? 0) !== $uid) {
                json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Template bawaan global tidak bisa diubah langsung. Silakan klik Gandakan untuk membuat versi kustom milik Anda.'], 403);
            }

            if (!in_array($category, $allowedCategories, true)) {
                $category = 'reply';
            }

            $safeBody = sanitize_outgoing_body_html($bodyHtml);
            if ($isDef === 1) {
                if ($existing['owner_id'] === null) {
                    $reset = db()->prepare('UPDATE email_templates SET is_default = 0 WHERE category = :cat AND owner_id IS NULL');
                    $reset->execute([':cat' => $category]);
                } else {
                    $reset = db()->prepare('UPDATE email_templates SET is_default = 0 WHERE category = :cat AND owner_id = :oid');
                    $reset->execute([':cat' => $category, ':oid' => (int) $existing['owner_id']]);
                }
            }

            $stmt = db()->prepare(
                'UPDATE email_templates
                 SET name = :name, category = :cat, subject_template = :subj, body_html = :body,
                     is_default = :def, description = :desc, updated_by = :uid
                 WHERE id = :id'
            );
            $stmt->execute([
                ':name' => $name,
                ':cat'  => $category,
                ':subj' => $subject,
                ':body' => $safeBody,
                ':def'  => $isDef,
                ':desc' => $desc,
                ':uid'  => $uid,
                ':id'   => $id,
            ]);

            log_activity('template_updated', 'Template email diperbarui: ' . $name, 'template', (string) $id);
            json_response(['ok' => true, 'message' => 'Perubahan template berhasil disimpan.']);

        case 'duplicate':
            $id = (int) ($data['id'] ?? 0);
            $stmt = db()->prepare('SELECT * FROM email_templates WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1');
            $stmt->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $orig = $stmt->fetch();
            if (!$orig) {
                json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Template asal tidak ditemukan.'], 404);
            }
            if (!$isSuper && $orig['owner_id'] !== null && (int) $orig['owner_id'] !== $uid) {
                json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.'], 403);
            }

            $newOwner = $isSuper ? $orig['owner_id'] : $uid;
            $newName  = $orig['name'] . ' (Kustom)';
            $newSlug  = slugify($orig['name']) . '-copy-' . substr(bin2hex(random_bytes(3)), 0, 6);
            $ins = db()->prepare(
                'INSERT INTO email_templates (owner_id, slug, name, category, subject_template, body_html, is_default, is_active, description, created_by, updated_by)
                 VALUES (:oid, :slug, :name, :cat, :subj, :body, 0, 1, :desc, :u1, :u2)'
            );
            $ins->execute([
                ':oid'  => $newOwner,
                ':slug' => $newSlug,
                ':name' => $newName,
                ':cat'  => $orig['category'],
                ':subj' => $orig['subject_template'],
                ':body' => $orig['body_html'],
                ':desc' => $orig['description'],
                ':u1'   => $uid,
                ':u2'   => $uid,
            ]);
            $newId = (int) db()->lastInsertId();
            log_activity('template_duplicated', 'Template digandakan: ' . $newName, 'template', (string) $newId);
            json_response(['ok' => true, 'message' => 'Template berhasil digandakan menjadi template kustom Anda.', 'id' => $newId]);

        case 'set_default':
            $id = (int) ($data['id'] ?? 0);
            $stmt = db()->prepare('SELECT id, name, category, owner_id FROM email_templates WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1');
            $stmt->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $tpl = $stmt->fetch();
            if (!$tpl) {
                json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Template tidak ditemukan.'], 404);
            }
            if (!$isSuper && (int) ($tpl['owner_id'] ?? 0) !== $uid) {
                json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Hanya dapat menjadikan template kustom milik Anda sebagai default pribadi.'], 403);
            }

            if ($tpl['owner_id'] === null) {
                $reset = db()->prepare('UPDATE email_templates SET is_default = 0 WHERE category = :cat AND owner_id IS NULL');
                $reset->execute([':cat' => $tpl['category']]);
            } else {
                $reset = db()->prepare('UPDATE email_templates SET is_default = 0 WHERE category = :cat AND owner_id = :oid');
                $reset->execute([':cat' => $tpl['category'], ':oid' => (int) $tpl['owner_id']]);
            }

            $set = db()->prepare('UPDATE email_templates SET is_default = 1, updated_by = :uid WHERE id = :id');
            $set->execute([':uid' => $uid, ':id' => $id]);

            log_activity('template_default', 'Template default diubah ke: ' . $tpl['name'], 'template', (string) $id);
            json_response(['ok' => true, 'message' => 'Template "' . $tpl['name'] . '" ditetapkan sebagai default.']);

        case 'delete':
            $id = (int) ($data['id'] ?? 0);
            $stmt = db()->prepare('SELECT id, name, owner_id FROM email_templates WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1');
            $stmt->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $tpl = $stmt->fetch();
            if (!$tpl) {
                json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Template tidak ditemukan.'], 404);
            }
            if (!$isSuper && (int) ($tpl['owner_id'] ?? 0) !== $uid) {
                json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Anda hanya dapat menghapus template kustom milik Anda sendiri.'], 403);
            }

            $del = db()->prepare('DELETE FROM email_templates WHERE id = :id');
            $del->execute([':id' => $id]);

            log_activity('template_deleted', 'Template dihapus: ' . $tpl['name'], 'template', (string) $id);
            json_response(['ok' => true, 'message' => 'Template berhasil dihapus.']);

        default:
            json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Aksi template tidak valid.'], 400);
    }
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    app_log('error', 'API templates.php error: ' . $e->getMessage());
    json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()], 400);
}

<?php
/**
 * Skyzz Mail — Authentication, Registration, Session Cache & Login Rate Limiting
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if (basename($_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME'] ?? '') === basename(__FILE__)) {
    http_response_code(403);
    exit('Akses langsung tidak diizinkan.');
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/database.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/functions.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/csrf.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/saas.php';

/**
 * Cek apakah pengguna sedang login.
 */
function is_logged_in(): bool
{
    return !empty($_SESSION['admin_id']) && is_int($_SESSION['admin_id']);
}

/**
 * Ambil data pengguna (Superadmin atau User) yang sedang login.
 * Menggunakan session cache 60 detik (cache login) agar perpindahan halaman & AJAX sangat cepat.
 */
function current_admin(bool $refresh = false): ?array
{
    static $admin = null;
    if (!is_logged_in()) {
        return null;
    }

    if ($admin !== null && !$refresh) {
        return $admin;
    }

    // Gunakan cache sesi (TTL 60 detik) untuk mengurangi query berulang per klik
    if (
        !$refresh
        && isset($_SESSION['admin_cache']['data'], $_SESSION['admin_cache']['ts'])
        && is_array($_SESSION['admin_cache']['data'])
        && ((int) $_SESSION['admin_cache']['data']['id'] === (int) $_SESSION['admin_id'])
        && (time() - (int) $_SESSION['admin_cache']['ts']) < 60
    ) {
        $admin = $_SESSION['admin_cache']['data'];
        return $admin;
    }

    ensure_skyzz_schema();

    try {
        $stmt = db()->prepare(
            'SELECT id, name, email, username, role, job_title, avatar_url,
                    selected_mailbox_id, plan_slug, plan_expires_at,
                    custom_sender_name, custom_signature, custom_footer_note,
                    is_active, last_login_at, last_login_ip, created_at
             FROM admins WHERE id = :id AND is_active = 1 LIMIT 1'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':id' => $_SESSION['admin_id']]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch();
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        app_log('error', 'current_admin DB error: ' . $e->getMessage());
        return null;
    }

    if (!$row) {
        logout_admin();
        return null;
    }

    $admin = $row;
    $_SESSION['admin_role']  = (string) $row['role'];
    $_SESSION['admin_cache'] = [
        'ts'   => time(),
        'data' => $row,
    ];
    return $admin;
}

/**
 * Wajibkan login untuk halaman PHP (berlaku untuk Superadmin maupun User).
 */
function require_admin(bool $jsonResponse = false): array
{
    if (!is_app_installed()) {
        if ($jsonResponse) {
            json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Aplikasi belum diinstal.'], 503);
        }
        redirect_to('install.php');
    }

    $admin = current_admin();
    if (!$admin) {
        if ($jsonResponse) {
            json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Sesi login telah berakhir. Silakan login kembali.'], 401);
        }
        redirect_to('login.php');
    }

    // Timeout sesi tidak aktif (8 jam)
    $lastActive = (int) ($_SESSION['last_activity'] ?? time());
    if ((time() - $lastActive) > 28800) {
        logout_admin();
        if ($jsonResponse) {
            json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Sesi kedaluwarsa karena tidak aktif.'], 401);
        }
        set_flash('warning', 'Sesi Anda telah berakhir karena tidak aktif. Silakan masuk kembali.');
        redirect_to('login.php');
    }

    $_SESSION['last_activity'] = time();
    return $admin;
}

/**
 * Cek apakah IP atau identifier sedang terkena rate limit login.
 */
function check_login_rate_limit(string $identifier): array
{
    try {
        $ip     = (string) ($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '0.0.0.0');
        $cutoff = date('Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - (LOGIN_LOCKOUT_MINUTES * 60));

        $stmt = db()->prepare(
            'SELECT COUNT(*) AS fail_count, MAX(attempted_at) AS last_attempt
             FROM login_attempts
             WHERE was_successful = 0
               AND attempted_at >= :cutoff
               AND (ip_address = :ip OR identifier = :ident)'
        );
        $stmt->execute([
            ':cutoff' => $cutoff,
            ':ip'     => $ip,
            ':ident'  => strtolower(trim($identifier)),
        ]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch() ?: ['fail_count' => 0, 'last_attempt' => null];
        $count = (int) $row['fail_count'];

        if ($count >= LOGIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
            $lastTs = $row['last_attempt'] ? strtotime((string) $row['last_attempt']) : time();
            $retryAfter = max(1, (int) ceil((($lastTs + LOGIN_LOCKOUT_MINUTES * 60) - time()) / 60));
            return ['blocked' => true, 'attempts' => $count, 'retry_minutes' => $retryAfter];
        }

        return ['blocked' => false, 'attempts' => $count, 'retry_minutes' => 0];
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        app_log('warning', 'check_login_rate_limit error: ' . $e->getMessage());
        return ['blocked' => false, 'attempts' => 0, 'retry_minutes' => 0];
    }
}

/**
 * Catat percobaan login ke tabel login_attempts.
 */
function record_login_attempt(string $identifier, bool $success): void
{
    try {
        $ip = (string) ($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '0.0.0.0');
        $stmt = db()->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO login_attempts (ip_address, identifier, was_successful) VALUES (:ip, :ident, :ok)'
        );
        $stmt->execute([
            ':ip'    => $ip,
            ':ident' => strtolower(trim($identifier)),
            ':ok'    => $success ? 1 : 0,
        ]);

        if ($success) {
            $clean = db()->prepare(
                'DELETE FROM login_attempts WHERE ip_address = :ip AND was_successful = 0'
            );
            $clean->execute([':ip' => $ip]);
        }
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        app_log('warning', 'record_login_attempt error: ' . $e->getMessage());
    }
}

/**
 * Proses autentikasi login (Superadmin atau User) + pilihan akun email aktif yang disediakan Superadmin.
 */
function attempt_admin_login(string $identifier, string $password, ?int $selectedMailboxId = null): array
{
    ensure_skyzz_schema();
    $identifier = trim($identifier);
    if ($identifier === '' || $password === '') {
        return ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Username/email dan kata sandi wajib diisi.'];
    }

    $rate = check_login_rate_limit($identifier);
    if ($rate['blocked']) {
        log_activity('login_blocked', 'Percobaan login diblokir karena melebihi batas gagal.', 'auth', null, 'warning');
        return [
            'ok'      => false,
            'message' => sprintf('Terlalu banyak percobaan login gagal. Coba lagi dalam %d menit.', $rate['retry_minutes']),
        ];
    }

    $stmt = db()->prepare(
        'SELECT id, name, email, username, password_hash, role, selected_mailbox_id, is_active
         FROM admins
         WHERE (LOWER(username) = LOWER(:ident1) OR LOWER(email) = LOWER(:ident2))
         LIMIT 1'
    );
    $stmt->execute([
        ':ident1' => $identifier,
        ':ident2' => $identifier,
    ]);
    $user = $stmt->fetch();

    if (!$user || (int) $user['is_active'] !== 1 || !password_verify($password, (string) $user['password_hash'])) {
        record_login_attempt($identifier, false);
        log_activity('login_failed', 'Login gagal untuk akun: ' . $identifier, 'auth', null, 'warning');
        return ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Username/email atau kata sandi tidak sesuai.'];
    }

    if (password_needs_rehash((string) $user['password_hash'], PASSWORD_DEFAULT)) {
        $newHash = password_hash($password, PASSWORD_DEFAULT);
        $upd = db()->prepare('UPDATE admins SET password_hash = :h WHERE id = :id');
        $upd->execute([':h' => $newHash, ':id' => (int) $user['id']]);
    }

    $isSuper = in_array((string) $user['role'], ['superadmin', 'admin'], true);
    $chosenMbId = $user['selected_mailbox_id'] ? (int) $user['selected_mailbox_id'] : null;

    if ($selectedMailboxId !== null && $selectedMailboxId > 0) {
        $mb = get_mailbox_by_id($selectedMailboxId);
        if ($mb && (int) $mb['is_active'] === 1 && ($isSuper || (int) $mb['allow_user_select'] === 1)) {
            $chosenMbId = $selectedMailboxId;
        }
    }

    session_regenerate_id(true);
    $_SESSION['admin_id']          = (int) $user['id'];
    $_SESSION['admin_role']        = (string) $user['role'];
    $_SESSION['active_mailbox_id'] = $chosenMbId;
    $_SESSION['last_activity']     = time();
    $_SESSION['csrf_token']        = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
    unset($_SESSION['admin_cache']);

    $ip = (string) ($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '');
    $updLogin = db()->prepare(
        'UPDATE admins SET last_login_at = NOW(), last_login_ip = :ip, selected_mailbox_id = :mid WHERE id = :id'
    );
    $updLogin->execute([
        ':ip'  => $ip,
        ':mid' => $chosenMbId,
        ':id'  => (int) $user['id'],
    ]);

    record_login_attempt($identifier, true);
    log_activity('login_success', 'Pengguna berhasil login ke Skyzz Mail (' . $user['role'] . ').', 'user', (string) $user['id'], 'success', (int) $user['id']);

    return ['ok' => true, 'message' => 'Login berhasil.'];
}

/**
 * Pendaftaran akun User baru (role='user', paket awal='free' 10 email/hari selamanya).
 */
function register_new_user(
    string $name,
    string $email,
    string $username,
    string $password,
    ?int $selectedMailboxId = null
): array {
    ensure_skyzz_schema();

    if (get_setting('allow_public_registration', '1') !== '1') {
        return ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Pendaftaran pengguna baru sedang dinonaktifkan oleh Superadmin.'];
    }

    $name     = trim($name);
    $email    = strtolower(trim($email));
    $username = strtolower(trim($username));

    if (strlen($name) < 2 || strlen($name) > 120) {
        return ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Nama lengkap wajib diisi (2–120 karakter).'];
    }
    if (!filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
        return ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Alamat email pribadi tidak valid.'];
    }
    if (!preg_match('/^[a-z0-9._-]{3,40}$/', $username)) {
        return ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Username harus 3–40 karakter (huruf kecil, angka, titik, strip, atau garis bawah).'];
    }
    if (strlen($password) < 8) {
        return ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Kata sandi minimal 8 karakter.'];
    }

    // Validasi pilihan mailbox yang disediakan Superadmin
    $validMailboxId = null;
    if ($selectedMailboxId !== null && $selectedMailboxId > 0) {
        $mb = get_mailbox_by_id($selectedMailboxId);
        if ($mb && (int) $mb['is_active'] === 1 && (int) $mb['allow_user_select'] === 1) {
            $validMailboxId = $selectedMailboxId;
        }
    }
    if ($validMailboxId === null) {
        $avail = get_selectable_mailboxes(false);
        if (!empty($avail)) {
            $validMailboxId = (int) $avail[0]['id'];
        }
    }

    // Cek duplikasi email / username
    $check = db()->prepare('SELECT id FROM admins WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(:em) OR LOWER(username) = LOWER(:un) LIMIT 1');
    $check->execute([':em' => $email, ':un' => $username]);
    if ($check->fetch()) {
        return ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Email atau username sudah terdaftar. Silakan gunakan yang lain atau masuk ke akun Anda.'];
    }

    $hash = password_hash($password, PASSWORD_DEFAULT);
    $stmt = db()->prepare(
        'INSERT INTO admins
            (name, email, username, password_hash, role, job_title, selected_mailbox_id, plan_slug, custom_sender_name, is_active)
         VALUES
            (:name, :em, :un, :ph, "user", "Pengguna Skyzz Mail", :mid, "free", :csn, 1)'
    );
    $stmt->execute([
        ':name' => $name,
        ':em'   => $email,
        ':un'   => $username,
        ':ph'   => $hash,
        ':mid'  => $validMailboxId,
        ':csn'  => $name,
    ]);
    $newUserId = (int) db()->lastInsertId();

    session_regenerate_id(true);
    $_SESSION['admin_id']          = $newUserId;
    $_SESSION['admin_role']        = 'user';
    $_SESSION['active_mailbox_id'] = $validMailboxId;
    $_SESSION['last_activity']     = time();
    $_SESSION['csrf_token']        = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
    unset($_SESSION['admin_cache']);

    log_activity('user_registered', 'Pengguna baru mendaftar di Skyzz Mail: ' . $username, 'user', (string) $newUserId, 'success', $newUserId);

    return ['ok' => true, 'message' => 'Pendaftaran berhasil! Selamat datang di Skyzz Mail.', 'user_id' => $newUserId];
}

/**
 * Logout dan hapus cookie sesi secara menyeluruh.
 */
function logout_admin(): void
{
    $uid = $_SESSION['admin_id'] ?? null;
    if ($uid) {
        log_activity('logout', 'Pengguna keluar dari sesi Skyzz Mail.', 'user', (string) $uid, 'success', (int) $uid);
    }

    $_SESSION = [];
    if (ini_get('session.use_cookies')) {
        $params = session_get_cookie_params();
        setcookie(
            session_name(),
            '',
            time() - 42000,
            $params['path'],
            $params['domain'],
            (bool) $params['secure'],
            (bool) $params['httponly']
        );
    }
    session_destroy();
}

<?php
/**
 * Skyzz Mail — Fast Server-Side File Cache
 * Menyimpan cache sementara (daftar email, statistik mailbox, pengaturan) di storage/cache/
 * agar halaman Inbox, Terkirim, dan Dashboard termuat cepat.
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if (basename($_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME'] ?? '') === basename(__FILE__)) {
    http_response_code(403);
    exit('Akses langsung tidak diizinkan.');
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/config.php';

/**
 * Pastikan direktori cache siap dan terlindungi.
 */
function cache_ensure_dir(): string
{
    $dir = defined('CACHE_PATH') ? CACHE_PATH : (STORAGE_PATH . '/cache');
    if (!is_dir($dir)) {
        @mkdir($dir, 0750, true);
    }
    $ht = $dir . '/.htaccess';
    if (!is_file($ht) && is_writable($dir)) {
        @file_put_contents($ht, "Require all denied\nDeny from all\n", LOCK_EX);
    }
    return $dir;
}

/**
 * Bangun path file cache yang aman (hanya huruf/angka/underscore/strip).
 */
function cache_file_path(string $key): string
{
    $safePrefix = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-]/', '_', substr($key, 0, 48)) ?: 'item';
    $hash       = hash('sha256', $key);
    return cache_ensure_dir() . '/' . $safePrefix . '_' . substr($hash, 0, 24) . '.cache.json';
}

/**
 * Ambil data dari cache jika belum kedaluwarsa.
 */
function cache_get(string $key): mixed
{
    $path = cache_file_path($key);
    if (!is_file($path) || !is_readable($path)) {
        return null;
    }

    $raw = @file_get_contents($path);
    if ($raw === false || $raw === '') {
        return null;
    }

    $decoded = json_decode($raw, true);
    if (!is_array($decoded) || !isset($decoded['expires_at'])) {
        @unlink($path);
        return null;
    }

    if ((int) $decoded['expires_at'] < time()) {
        @unlink($path);
        return null;
    }

    return $decoded['data'] ?? null;
}

/**
 * Simpan data ke cache dengan TTL (detik).
 */
function cache_set(string $key, mixed $data, int $ttlSeconds = 60): bool
{
    $path = cache_file_path($key);
    $payload = json_encode([
        'key'        => $key,
        'stored_at'  => time(),
        'expires_at' => time() + max(5, $ttlSeconds),
        'data'       => $data,
    ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);

    if ($payload === false) {
        return false;
    }

    return @file_put_contents($path, $payload, LOCK_EX) !== false;
}

/**
 * Hapus satu item cache berdasarkan key.
 */
function cache_delete(string $key): void
{
    $path = cache_file_path($key);
    if (is_file($path)) {
        @unlink($path);
    }
}

/**
 * Hapus semua file cache yang dimulai dengan prefix tertentu (mis. 'mb_1_' atau 'stats_').
 */
function cache_forget_prefix(string $prefix): int
{
    $dir = cache_ensure_dir();
    $safePrefix = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-]/', '_', substr($prefix, 0, 48)) ?: '';
    if ($safePrefix === '') {
        return 0;
    }

    $files = glob($dir . '/' . $safePrefix . '*.cache.json') ?: [];
    $removed = 0;
    foreach ($files as $f) {
        if (is_file($f) && @unlink($f)) {
            $removed++;
        }
    }
    return $removed;
}

/**
 * Bersihkan seluruh file cache di storage/cache/.
 */
function cache_flush_all(): int
{
    $dir = cache_ensure_dir();
    $files = glob($dir . '/*.cache.json') ?: [];
    $removed = 0;
    foreach ($files as $f) {
        if (is_file($f) && @unlink($f)) {
            $removed++;
        }
    }
    return $removed;
}

<?php
/**
 * Support Septian — AES-256-GCM Encryption Helper
 * Mengenkripsi OAuth tokens, Client Secret, dan Google App Password sebelum disimpan.
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if (basename($_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME'] ?? '') === basename(__FILE__)) {
    http_response_code(403);
    exit('Akses langsung tidak diizinkan.');
}

const CRYPTO_CIPHER = 'aes-256-gcm';

/**
 * Mengembalikan kunci biner 32-byte dari APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
 */
function crypto_get_key(): string
{
    $rawKey = (string) app_config('encryption_key', '');
    if ($rawKey === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('Kunci enkripsi aplikasi belum dikonfigurasi. Jalankan install.php.');
    }

    if (ctype_xdigit($rawKey) && strlen($rawKey) === 64) {
        $bin = hex2bin($rawKey);
        if ($bin !== false && strlen($bin) === 32) {
            return $bin;
        }
    }

    return hash('sha256', $rawKey, true);
}

/**
 * Enkripsi teks menggunakan AES-256-GCM.
 */
function crypto_encrypt(string $plaintext): string
{
    if ($plaintext === '') {
        return '';
    }

    if (!function_exists('openssl_encrypt')) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Ekstensi PHP OpenSSL belum aktif di server hosting.');
    }

    $key = crypto_get_key();
    $iv  = random_bytes(12);
    $tag = '';

    $ciphertext = openssl_encrypt(
        $plaintext,
        CRYPTO_CIPHER,
        $key,
        OPENSSL_RAW_DATA,
        $iv,
        $tag,
        '',
        16
    );

    if ($ciphertext === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Gagal mengenkripsi data sensitif.');
    }

    return 'enc:v1:' . base64_encode($iv . $tag . $ciphertext);
}

/**
 * Dekripsi teks hasil crypto_encrypt().
 */
function crypto_decrypt(?string $payload): string
{
    if ($payload === null || $payload === '') {
        return '';
    }

    if (!str_starts_with($payload, 'enc:v1:')) {
        return $payload;
    }

    if (!function_exists('openssl_decrypt')) {
        return '';
    }

    $decoded = base64_decode(substr($payload, 7), true);
    if ($decoded === false || strlen($decoded) < 28) {
        return '';
    }

    $iv         = substr($decoded, 0, 12);
    $tag        = substr($decoded, 12, 16);
    $ciphertext = substr($decoded, 28);

    try {
        $plaintext = openssl_decrypt(
            $ciphertext,
            CRYPTO_CIPHER,
            crypto_get_key(),
            OPENSSL_RAW_DATA,
            $iv,
            $tag
        );
        return $plaintext === false ? '' : $plaintext;
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        return '';
    }
}

<?php
/**
 * Support Septian — CSRF Protection Module
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if (basename($_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME'] ?? '') === basename(__FILE__)) {
    http_response_code(403);
    exit('Akses langsung tidak diizinkan.');
}

/**
 * Ambil atau buat CSRF token per sesi.
 */
function csrf_token(): string
{
    if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token']) || !is_string($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
        $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
    }
    return $_SESSION['csrf_token'];
}

/**
 * Cetak hidden input HTML untuk form POST.
 */
function csrf_field(): string
{
    return '<input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="' . htmlspecialchars(csrf_token(), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '">';
}

/**
 * Verifikasi CSRF token dari POST body atau HTTP header X-CSRF-Token.
 */
function verify_csrf(?string $provided = null): bool
{
    $expected = $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '';
    if (!is_string($expected) || $expected === '') {
        return false;
    }

    if ($provided === null) {
        $provided = $_POST['csrf_token']
            ?? $_SERVER['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN']
            ?? '';
    }

    if (!is_string($provided) || $provided === '') {
        return false;
    }

    return hash_equals($expected, $provided);
}

/**
 * Wajibkan CSRF valid pada endpoint POST/PUT/DELETE.
 */
function require_csrf(bool $jsonResponse = false): void
{
    if (!verify_csrf()) {
        if ($jsonResponse) {
            http_response_code(403);
            header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
            echo json_encode([
                'ok'      => false,
                'message' => 'Sesi keamanan (CSRF) tidak valid atau kedaluwarsa. Muat ulang halaman lalu coba lagi.',
            ]);
            exit;
        }
        http_response_code(403);
        exit('Permintaan ditolak: token keamanan CSRF tidak valid.');
    }
}
